request.style: English, Salvation Army brass band, cornets, tenor horns, euphoniums and tubas, snare drum and bass drum march, an open-air congregation singing in unison behind a strong male officer leading, bold and triumphant march, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
If you confess with your mouth
That Jesus Christ is Lord
And believe within your heart
That God has raised him up
You will be saved

[Chorus]
The Lord is my strength and my song
He has become my salvation
Shouts of joy in the tents of the righteous
The Lord's right hand does valiantly

[Verse]
Everyone who calls on him
Will never be put to shame
There is no Jew or Greek
For he is Lord of all
Call on his name

[Chorus]
The Lord is my strength and my song
He has become my salvation
Shouts of joy in the tents of the righteous
The Lord's right hand does valiantly

[Outro]
Call on his name
